title: RelayEnvelope
description: Discriminated union of every envelope type the relay accepts. This is the complete contract surface: there is no branch for restraint, gesture, outfit, title, Moodle, follow, collar, custom-trigger, arbitrary chat, or any other gameplay command, and no branch matches an unrecognized `type`. A payload that does not conform to exactly one of these schemas (including any unknown `type` or extra property, since every branch sets `additionalProperties: false`) fails closed.
